items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially is active today vs. the Raiders after optimism on calf injury.
items.why: Calf injury; did not practice fully but felt better Saturday, sources optimistic no setbacks. McVay called minor. ETR had GTD/OPTIMISM.
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1; high upside in 4:25 window despite limited practice.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full routes/targets expected; reverse any Davante Adams absence beneficiaries if pitch count.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall officially inactive; was unlikely after quad strain, not full participant.
items.why: Quad strain after missing three games; limited practice, workout possible but early. Schefter confirmed inactive. ETR GTD/PESS.
items.implication: Sit Breece; continue ramp next week vs Raiders. Primary back role stays with backup.
items.opportunity: Full workload for Jets RB2/handcuff (Braelon Allen type); elevated snap/carry share vs Miami.

items.text: Lamar Jackson is OUT for Week 7. ETR Sunday morning summary lists him clearly OUT amid weekend reports.
items.why: Ankle injury; limited practice, ruled out after missing prior games. Rapoport noted he was close but sits, expected next week.
items.implication: Ravens turn to backup QB; fades Lamar fantasy value this week, boosts any Huntley streams or Ravens skill players slightly in pass game.
items.opportunity: Increased volume potential for Ravens WRs/TEs/RBs if game script pass-heavy.

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT for Eagles Week 7 (MNF vs DAL).
items.why: Hamstring; missed full week practice, ruled out Saturday. Lingering issue, third miss this season.
items.implication: Sit completely; Eagles WR corps depleted with Wicks also out. Berry had loved pre-OUT.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for remaining Eagles WRs (Lemon, etc.) and Goedert; more volume to Saquon if active.
items.conflict: Berry pre-report LOVE now voided by OUT.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs (ankle turned on purposeful slide) among Sunday injuries ETR watching closely.
items.why: Ankle turned during slide; post-game monitoring for severity.
items.implication: Potential downgrade or limited next week; check Monday reports. Handcuff elevation if misses time.
items.opportunity: David Montgomery or Lions RB depth snaps/carries if Gibbs limited/out.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle (shoulder) among key Sunday injuries ETR monitoring.
items.why: Shoulder issue during game; post-game status TBD.
items.implication: Potential next-week impact; monitor for DEN WR depth if limited.
items.opportunity: Courtland Sutton or other DEN WRs elevated targets if Waddle misses time.

items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo expected to resume lead back role vs Texans; finished with 124 yards on 17 carries and 1 TD.
items.why: Sources expected lead role; produced heavily. ETR noted hamstring watch post but clear lead.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with volume; continue as primary if healthy.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry/red-zone share confirmed; Tracy (hamstring) secondary.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey went to locker room (quad/thigh) then returned to game.
items.why: Thigh/quad issue mid-game; left then cleared to return. ETR watching post-game.
items.implication: Monitor post-game reports for next week; limited impact if finished game but usage may have dipped temporarily.
items.opportunity: If limited snaps, backups (Mason? but different team) or 49ers pass game elevated short-term; reverse if full return.

items.text: Adam Levitan: All ETR projections updated to latest news (Lamar/Puka/Breece etc.); player-specific DFS notes on key GTD and sneaky scratches.
items.why: Reflects ETR summary statuses; notes crucial DFS on Lamar/Puka/Breece, tempted CMC amid 49ers WR outs, sneaky scratches (Egbuka etc).
items.implication: Use updated ranks/projs for start/sit; aligns perfectly with Schefter/Rapoport/ETR facts.
items.opportunity: Role/usage adjustments baked in for beneficiaries of outs.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY for Eagles vs Cowboys (MNF).
items.why: Returned to practice (full Sat after limited); sources and reports trending positive after missing games.
items.implication: Strong start candidate if active; efficient when healthy. Monitor final inactives for MNF.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries/red-zone if cleared; reverse any backup elevation.

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks OUT for Eagles Week 7 alongside DeVonta Smith.
items.why: Ankle injury; no practice all week, ruled out Saturday after late prior-game issue.
items.implication: Sit; further thins Eagles pass catchers for MNF.
items.opportunity: Significant target bump for depth WRs and TE; check Goedert/Saquon usage expansion.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs activated and expected to play Sunday after return.
items.why: Activated from IR/absence; ETR lists IN. Rapoport noted returns to field.
items.implication: Immediate RB2/flex consideration post-layoff; monitor snap share/workload ramp.
items.opportunity: Lead carries/goal-line if full go; reverse any backup (Lloyd) elevation.

items.why: Ankle; unlikely per Rapoport, officially out. Missed prior.
items.implication: Boosts opposing pass game (ARI WRs like Marvin Harrison/Michael Wilson) fantasy upside.
items.opportunity: Higher completion/target efficiency for Cardinals receivers.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES A.J. Brown in Week 7 for usage and matchup (vs CHI).
items.why: Strong usage/matchup; Bears allow yardage. Part of pass-catcher loves with Kraft.
items.implication: Priority start as WR1/2; high target share expected.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets vs soft secondary; red-zone upside.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES Tucker Kraft (TE buffet vs DET defense allowing TE TDs/points).
items.why: Lions vulnerable to TEs (9 TDs allowed, multiple high-scoring TEs); volume opportunity.

items.text: Berry LOVES volume RBs Jaylen Warren, Chuba Hubbard, Bucky Irving in Week 7.
items.why: Expected heavy workloads/carries in favorable spots; Saquon if active also highlighted.

items.text: Matthew Berry HATES Rome Odunze vs NE (shadow by Gonzalez, outside targets).
items.why: 90% outside targets where Gonzalez shadows; limited high-scoring games history.
items.implication: Sit/fade in tougher matchup; lower expectations.

items.text: Berry HATES Josh Downs and Travis Kelce (tough D matchups) in Week 7.
items.why: Difficult defensive matchups limiting upside/volume efficiency.
items.implication: Fade or sit in favor of better spots; Kelce tough D noted.
